spec:
Cross-account /topics consolidation for Aaradhya.

Context: Aaradhya runs multiple parallel Claude accounts, each with its own memory filesystem and its own /topics/*.md files. He wants each account's /topics/ content consolidated into one place — NOT a single-account internal merge (a prior task, task_2026-08-13_001, was created on that misreading and is cancelled — ignore it).

Mechanism note: no orch tool can write directly into another account's memory store. push_memory_entry/read_team_memory is a message-passing log, not a file-write proxy. So this has to happen via that log:

Steps (for EVERY account running this task, including the one that claims it):
1. On your own account, memory_list(path_prefix="/topics/") to get your full /topics/ file list.
2. memory_read every /topics/*.md file on your account.
3. push_memory_entry(account=<your account name>, text=<all your /topics/ content, verbatim, one file per section with the original filename as a header, all [stated]/[observed]/[inferred] tags preserved>).
4. Once all participating accounts have pushed (check via read_team_memory for entries matching this task_id in their text), one account should read_team_memory, pull every account's pushed /topics/ export, and produce ONE consolidated file containing all of it — organized by account then by original topic file, so provenance stays traceable. Do not drop, summarize, or reword any line.
5. Report back (via a new push_memory_entry) where the consolidated file ended up and which accounts' data is included / still missing.

Do not delete any account's original /topics/ files as part of this task. Flag them as superseded once consolidated; actual deletion needs Aaradhya's explicit separate confirmation per account.

Reference this task's id (task_2026-08-13_001 successor) in any status pushes so accounts can find each other's progress.
